name: Shinagawa Zakuro
source:
Detective working at the Shinkiba Detective Agency. He specialises in tail investigations due to his small stature. He spends every day in a lazy mood, but he does his job when push comes to shove. He admires Oosaki and calls him his senior.

[Translated from [url=https://adeltaz1.wixsite.com/owen]the official website[/url].]
